preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least 1 CLE token to call approve()

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the allowance() and _approve() functions where the parameter 'owner' shadows the inherited Ownable.owner state variable. Call approve() with spender=attacker_address and amount=0, which will trigger _approve() with owner=msg.sender. This will overwrite the contract's owner state variable to msg.sender (attacker) because _approve() writes to _allowances[owner][spender] where 'owner' refers to the function parameter, not the contract owner. After this, attacker becomes owner and can call owner-only functions like excludeFromFee, setMaxTxPercent, or transferDustBNB.
